canonical_statement: The study aimed to determine long-term disease-specific and general health-related quality of life and depressive symptoms in hemifacial spasm patients receiving Abo-botulinum toxin A over five years.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This study aimed to determine the long-term quality of life (QoL) in hemifacial spasm (HFS) patients after treating with Abo-botulinum toxin A (Abo-BTX).

canonical_statement: The investigation was a five-year prospective study in which Abo-BTX A injections were administered at three-month intervals.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The five-year prospective study of the quality of life for HFS patients treated with Abo-BTX A injections at three-month intervals was designed following the Declaration of Helsinki and International Conference on Harmonization/Good Clinical Practice Guidelines.

canonical_statement: Seventy-four patients (56 females and 18 males) were included in the analysis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In total, 56 females and 18 males, ranging in age from 20 to 75 years (mean ± standard deviation of 60.8 ± 7.5 years), were eligible in the study from February 2012 to February 2017. Those patients were included in the analysis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients who did not sign inform consent; were potentially pregnant without proper contraception or lactating; with significant medical conditions that could influence trial evaluations, for example bleeding tendency, significant cardiovascular, rheumatological, or neuropsychiatric disease except depressive disorder; or a history of allergy to BTX A were excluded.

canonical_statement: Abo-BTX A was diluted to approximately 333.33 units/mL; each session delivered 100 units intramuscularly as 25 units at each of four ipsilateral orbicularis oculi/oris sites, repeated every three months for 20 injections.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: First, 500 units of Abo-BTX A, freeze-dried powder, were diluted into 1.5 mL of normal saline solution, approximately 333.33 units of Abo-BTX A per 1.0 mL, and used within 2 h after dilution. Twenty injections, one every three months, to a total of 100 unit of Abo-BTX A, as intramuscular injections in ipsilateral orbicularis occuli and orbicularis oris (25 unit per injected site, for upper outer and lower outer of each muscle), was performed using 29G insulin needles for each patient (Figure 5).

exposures.details: 25 units at each of four ipsilateral orbicularis oculi/oris sites per treatment session

canonical_statement: HFS-30, AIMS, SF-36, and CES-D were completed at baseline and before the next visit.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: After performing a complete history and physical examination, all patients were assigned to complete the HFS 30, AIMS, Medical Outcomes 36-Item Short Form Health Survey (SF-36), and CES-D questionnaires at baseline and before the next visit.

canonical_statement: The primary outcome was change from baseline in mean HFS-30, AIMS, and SF-36 after five years of Abo-BTX A injections.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The primary outcome was the change from baseline in mean HFS 30, AIMS, and SF-36 questionnaire, after five years of injections of Abo-BTX A.

concept.text: Change from baseline in HFS-30, AIMS, and SF-36

outcome.definition: Primary efficacy outcome combining the three stated questionnaire/scale changes after five years

canonical_statement: The secondary endpoint was change in mean CES-D score.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The secondary endpoints were the changes in the mean CES-D score.

outcome.definition: Change in mean Center for Epidemiologic Studies-Depression score

canonical_statement: HFS-30 is a 30-item disease-specific HRQoL questionnaire spanning seven subscales, with items scored from 0 (never) to 4 (always).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The HFS 30, a validated questionnaire with good reliability of disease-specific HRQoL in patients with HFS, is composed of seven subscales (30 items): mobility (5 items), activity daily living (5 items), and communication (3 items) are classified as physical domain; emotional wellbeing (7 items), stigma (4 items), social support (3 items), and cognition (3 items), are classified as mental health domain. All the items are scored on a 5-point scale ranging from 0 (never) to 4 (always) with a consistency of Cronbach’s alpha >0.7.

outcome.definition: 30-item disease-specific HRQoL questionnaire with seven subscales and 0-4 item scoring

canonical_statement: AIMS rates severity of face and mouth movements across seven regions using five-point ratings.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The abnormal involuntary movement scale (AIMS) rates in seven regions the severity of face and mouth movements, each on a five-point scale in the overall severity, judged on the amplitude of muscle movements, incapacitation postures, and positions.

outcome.definition: Abnormal Involuntary Movement Scale rating face and mouth movement severity across seven regions

canonical_statement: SF-36 contains 36 items across eight domains: physical functioning, role-physical, role-emotional, vitality, mental health, social functioning, bodily pain, and general health.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The SF-36 scale is composed of 36 items with eight domains: physical functioning (PF), role limitations due to physical health (RP), role limitations due to emotional problems (RE), vitality (VT), mental health (MH), social functioning (SF), bodily pain (BP), and general health (GH).

outcome.definition: 36-item general HRQoL instrument with eight domains

canonical_statement: CES-D contains 20 items scored 0 to 3, yielding a total score from 0 to 60; a score of 20 or more was used to indicate risk of clinical depression.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: CES-D questionnaire has 20 items with six subscales reflecting the major symptoms of depression: depressed mood, feelings of guilt, worthlessness and helplessness, psychomotor retardation, loss of appetite, and sleep difficulties. The CES-D score ranges from 0 to 3 for each item (0 = rarely or none of the time, 1 = some or little of the time, 2 = moderately or much of the time, and 3 = most or almost all the time); the sum of its scores, therefore, ranges from 0 to 60, with higher scores demonstrating greater depressive symptoms. The scores of 20 or more determined risk of clinical depression with sensitivity of 79% and specificity of 80%.

outcome.definition: 20-item depression screening score; 0-60 total; >=20 used as risk threshold

canonical_statement: Repeated-measures general linear models were used every three months and on annual averages; linear, quadratic, and cubic models were considered, with two-tailed alpha 0.05.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The mean scores (standard error) of QoL and CES-D were analyzed by general linear model by repeated measurement method, every three months of the five-year treatment. The tests between visits, considering linear, quadratic, and cubic significant models, were used to consider the maximum effect of mean change over the entire five-year treatment. The average one-year data were also analyzed by general linear model by repeated measurement method for five years, while the linear, quadratic, and cubic significant models were used to consider the maximum effect of mean change from baseline. All statistical tests were two-tailed with a significance level of α = 0.05 (Figure 5).

canonical_statement: Neutralizing antibodies against Abo-BTX A were not evaluated in hemifacial spasm patients in this study; the authors presented antibody-mediated waning as a hypothesis requiring further study.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the neutralizing antibody Abo-BTX A has not been studied in hemifacial spasm patient. In this study, most likely reason there was a decrease in quality of life in the fifth year of treatment is the neutralizing antibody’s effect decreased to a sub-clinical response after long-term treatment. The association of neutralized antibody against Abo-BTX A and decrease of long-term QoL should be observed in further studies.

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that Abo-BTX A improved quality of life in the first few years, but only the SF-36 general-health domain showed significant improvement across five years.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Abo-BTX A improved QoL in the first few years in HFS patients. Only general health domain showed significant improvement across five-year treatment.
